name: Seifuku Kanojo
source:
"I've spread your confession everywhere!"

A devastating heartbreak experienced at a school in the big city. 
"My school life is completely over."

Living through days of despair, but everything changes with a transfer to Kyushu! 
"Why are there only beautiful people around me!?!?" 
The transfer destination is Fukuoka, a city famous for its beautiful girls.

Overwhelmed by the difference from the metropolis, I meet Yui Konomi. 
"Do you like school uniforms?" 
"Kanojo", My classmate looks stunning in a school uniform.

"Let's exchange Constagrams! " 
"Are you playing Constagrams? Let's exchange with me!" 
And I meet my junior, Himari Tamayori, and my senior, Mio Yahiro, and we become friends through exchanging SNS contacts.

The love story with them begins now!

[Translated from [url=https://dlsoft.dmm.com/detail/ieg_0002/]DMM GAMES[/url]]
